create_manus_mocap_client: create a ManusMocap client that connects to a ZMQ broadcasted mocap data source on a specified port
get_latest_mocap_data: get the latest mocap joint position data as a numpy array from the ManusMocap client
close_mocap_connection: close the ManusMocap ZMQ socket and stop the background receive thread gracefully
review_recv_loop: review the ManusMocap _recv_loop method that continuously receives ZMQ messages and updates latest data
refactor_mocap_port_default: refactor the ManusMocap class to accept a configurable default port for the ZMQ SUB socket connection
